items.quote: the number I'm more proud of is two thousand. This is how many agents I coach for exactly
items.statement: Olga Semenenko has coached 2000 agents on improving their sales strategies.

items.quote: What broke the deal is the way you talk to him in the first seconds of the call.
items.statement: Agents should change the way they communicate with clients to improve sales outcomes.

items.quote: when you follow the same pattern as every other agent he doesn't see an expert.
items.statement: Clients often feel confused and interchangeable when agents follow the same questioning patterns.

items.quote: can you just send me some options?
items.statement: Clients frequently ask for options or details instead of engaging further after the initial call.

items.quote: the expert and the authority in the client's mind because he is not afraid to ask difficult questions.
items.statement: Successful agents are perceived as experts due to their ability to ask challenging questions.

items.quote: they pitch too early, recommend too early, present properties before the client understands his own decisions.
items.statement: Agents who pitch too early lose the opportunity for genuine client conversations.

items.quote: your first goal is not to sell the property. Your first goal is to make the client comfortable enough to tell you the truth.
items.statement: The first goal in the sales call should be to make the client comfortable enough to reveal their true intentions.
